rationale: Identity verification was done correctly via name + ZIP. However, the agent: 1) stated order statuses (canceled/refunded, delivered) without any tool evidence; 2) provided a tracking number without using tools to retrieve it; 3) did not actually check or report in-transit status via tools; and 4) updated the default address without obtaining explicit confirmation before performing the write, violating the confirmation requirement. While the tablet storage detail was correctly sourced, the fabricated/unsupported information and unconfirmed write change cause the interaction to fail policy compliance.
